scope.target: Issue #194 long-running validation delegation and no-polling governance
constraints: Keep canonical aggregate validation and fail-closed outcomes
Classify release, nightly-full, full-matrix, and at-least-120-second commands as long-running
Dispatch only after focused validation and a clean immutable commit
Use the least expensive capable external task and prohibit primary-conversation polling
Require one bounded final report and keep timeout, interruption, missing evidence, and blocked execution non-passing
Do not enable parallel aggregate execution without dependency and artifact-isolation contract evidence

Repair validation failures inside the external task
Create a v0.13 tag, Release, or publication
Close Issues or mutate Project fields
